verdict.rationale: Netlify's docs show a built-in object storage API (Netlify Blobs) explicitly used for file uploads: `const uploads = getStore("file-uploads")`, which is the store name in the example. This is first-party evidence of persisting user-generated uploads via a native storage primitive rather than a third-party bucket. Missing for 10: deeper documentation of the Blobs API (durability, size limits, retrieval), and independent/hands-on community corroboration of using it for uploads.
